purpose: Teach: 熟語/官能/固体/開校/国体/農耕/高分子/感嘆

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、容疑者の熟語使いを、警察、分析されてますね
lines.en: So the police are analyzing the suspect's use of idioms in this case, aren't they?
lines.style: Curious, tentative phrasing — testing an idea rather than stating it. Respectful upturn at the end. Genuine interest, not challenge. Slight pause before speaking, like thinking aloud.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、官能小説に絡む詐欺事件にも対応します
lines.en: The police handle fraud cases involving obscene literature as well.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, steady delivery. Professional but not cold. Each phrase has equal weight. No apology in the tone — this is simply what the work includes. Clear gaze.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、密輸固体物質を、警察、押収されますね
lines.en: In this case, the police are conducting a forensic examination of the solid material residue, aren't they?
lines.style: Respectful inquiry with genuine wonder. Slight lean forward in attention. Phrasing deferential but not uncertain. Wanting to understand the full scope of the investigation.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、新校開校式の警備を担当します
lines.en: The police are also responsible for security at the new school's opening ceremony.
lines.style: Declarative, concrete. No inflection of difficulty or burden. Simply listing responsibilities within the day's work. Steady breath, even pace. Professional weight.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、国体行事の警備を、警察、強化されますね
lines.en: So the police are reinforcing security for the National Sports Festival events in this case, aren't they?
lines.style: Thoughtful, following the pattern of previous questions. Respectful deference in the upturn. Not aggressive — seeking confirmation of priority and scope. Attentive listening underneath.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、農耕地での盗難事件も扱います
lines.en: The police also handle theft cases in agricultural areas.
lines.style: Steady, unhurried delivery. Including this quietly alongside the larger cases — not diminishing it. Even tone. Practical acknowledgment of scope.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、高分子素材の犯行残留を、警察、鑑定されますね
lines.en: In this case, the police are conducting a forensic analysis of the polymer material traces left at the crime scene, aren't they?
lines.style: Focused, technical curiosity. Precise phrasing. Respectful but engaged — asking about specific investigative method. Small nod of understanding in the tone.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、市民の感嘆を呼ぶ事案より地道な捜査を重視します
lines.en: The police prioritize steady investigative work over cases that capture public admiration.
lines.style: Firm and clear, a departure from the procedural tone. More weight on conviction. Not defensive, but grounded. Direct eye contact. This is a principle, not just information.
